en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large group of men, women, and children in early 20th‑century dress standing in a long line outdoors. In the foreground, numerous shallow rectangular drying trays filled with small round objects (likely seeds or fruit) are laid out in a grid on the ground. Several children and youths stand closer to the camera. In the background are wooden houses, sheds, and trees, and a larger industrial-looking building with a sign on its upper facade. The overall scene appears to depict workers or a community at an agricultural or processing facility.
